description: JStock is open on the Portfolio Management tab showing existing buy transactions for AAPL, MSFT, and NVDA. Your task is to record a new buy transaction: you purchased 50 shares of Meta Platforms (META) at a price of $490.00 per share on February 1, 2024. To add the transaction: click the 'Buy...' button at the bottom of the portfolio window, then in the dialog that appears, enter the stock symbol 'META', set the number of units to 50, set the purchase price to 490.00, set the date to February 1, 2024, and click OK to confirm. The new META buy transaction should then appear in the portfolio table.
